WHY.Improved Corruption: Every Affliction guide opens here: an instant Corruption.
WHY.Soul Siphon: Mobalytics' drain-tank core: Drain Life heals more for each of your effects on the target.
WHY.Shadow Mastery: Your biggest Shadow damage boost; Icy Veins' leveling order takes it at 46–50 (Mobalytics at 35–39).
WHY.Soul Link: The 21-point talent. wowfdb: until you have it, Demonology is “a worse Affliction”.
WHY.Demonic Pact: The 31-point talent: your Sacrifice buff survives summoning a new demon (wowfdb).
WHY.Demonic Brand: Searing Pain marks the target for your pet's next 6 attacks (wording changed Oct 9).
WHY.Demonic Sacrifice: Icy Veins: don't actually use it until Demonic Pact at 40.
WHY.Stormstrike: The spec starts here (Icy Veins, wowfdb).
WHY.Shamanistic Focus: Shocks and Lightning Shield cost 45% less mana: you stop rationing shocks (wowfdb).
WHY.Improved Stormstrike: Dodges and parries can reset Stormstrike; also 50% mana regen while casting (wowfdb).
WHY.Water Shield: Icy Veins' text says 42; its own calculator places it at 43 because Restoration needs 10 points first.
WHY.Maelstrom Weapon: Free, instant Lightning Bolt at 5 stacks.
WHY.Rage of the Farseer: +30% attack speed for 25 s on a 3-minute cooldown (wowfdb; marked unconfirmed there).

PATH_NODES.title: No talents yet
PATH_NODES.body: Shadow Bolt, Imp, wand at 5 (Enchanting). Voidwalker at 10.

PATH_NODES.title: Affliction starts
PATH_NODES.body: First 4 points into Suppression (4% hit), then Improved Corruption 14-18 (Icy Veins). With Legacy Talented maxed, points start up to 5 levels earlier.

PATH_NODES.title: Siphon Life
PATH_NODES.body: Siphon Life at 30: another instant Shadow DoT that heals you. Weak when first taken, so use it on mobs that will live through most of it. Felhunter class quest at 30.

PATH_NODES.title: Dual Spec: Demonology as Spec 2 for groups
PATH_NODES.body: Not a leveling switch. Spec 1 stays Affliction for questing; Spec 2 gets Icy Veins' Demonology order (31 points, Demonic Pact) for dungeons and raids. No respec cost after this.
PATH_NODES.quote: keep Affliction to 40, take dual specialization when it unlocks, and treat your second spec as the group spec.

PATH_NODES.title: Demonic Sacrifice
PATH_NODES.body: Spec 1's 11-point Demonology dip ends here. For solo play sacrifice a Felhunter: 3% of max health every 4 sec for 2 hours, removed when you summon a demon.

PATH_NODES.title: Wrack, the Affliction capstone
PATH_NODES.body: A 6-second Shadow channel that also makes your other Shadow DoTs deal 10% more while it's up. Best with Corruption, Bane of Agony and Siphon Life ticking. It doesn't heal, so keep Drain Life for health.

PATH_NODES.title: Endgame pick
PATH_NODES.body: Raid builds: Affliction 30/0/21 or Demonology 2/31/18 (Mobalytics, Oct 30). Both are in the talent planner as final builds.

MACROS.title: Pet attack and follow
MACROS.code:
#showtooltip
/petattack [harm,nodead]
/petfollow [mod:ctrl]
MACROS.does: Sends the pet at your target. Hold Ctrl to call it back, which you want before you Fear. Affliction from 41: pet is sacrificed, so this is for Spec 2 (Demonology).

#showtooltip

/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Corruption

MACROS.code:

/castsequence reset=target/combat Corruption, Bane of Agony
MACROS.does: First press sends the pet and casts Corruption; second press applies Bane of Agony. Resets on a new target.

/cast [harm,nodead] Amplify Curse
/cast [harm,nodead] Bane of Agony
MACROS.does: Pops Amplify Curse (off the global cooldown) then lands an empowered Bane of Agony in one press.

MACROS.code:
#showtooltip Wrack
/stopattack
/cast [mod:shift] Drain Soul; [mod:ctrl] Drain Life; Wrack
MACROS.does: Plain casts Wrack; Shift for Drain Soul on a dying mob; Ctrl for Drain Life when you need health.

/stopmacro [mod:shift]
/use Major Healthstone
/use Greater Healthstone

/stopmacro [mod:shift]

/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Fear
MACROS.does: Stops the pet so it doesn't break Fear, then Fears your mouseover or target.

/cast [mod:ctrl,nochanneling:Drain Mana] Drain Mana; [nochanneling:Drain Life] Drain Life

/cast [nochanneling:Drain Soul,harm,nodead] Drain Soul

ROUTES.zone: Valley of Trials · Orc Shaman, levels 1–6
steps: Kaltunk (43.69): Your Place In The World. Turn in at The Den entrance (42.68), take Cutting Teeth.
Kill Mottled Boars (skin them for Skinning). Take Sarkoth (41.63), kill Sarkoth just south (41.67), turn in and take part 2.
The Den: turn in Cutting Teeth and Sarkoth; take Sting of the Scorpid and the Rune-Inscribed Tablet. Turn the tablet in at the Shaman trainer (42.69) and train.

Take Vile Familiars, Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise (43.67) and Lazy Peons (45.69, level 3). Do them together: Scorpid Worker tails, cactus apples, Foreman's Blackjack on peons, Vile Familiars outside the cave (45.57).
Turn in; next to the Shaman trainer take Call of Earth and your level-4 spells; take Burning Blade Medallion and Thazz'ril's Pick.
Cave (45.56): right side to Yarrog Baneshadow (43.53), left side for Thazz'ril's Pick (44.54), Felstalker hooves for Call of Earth.
Be level 5, hearth, turn in, take Report to Sen'jin Village. Finish Call of Earth at Spirit Rock (44.76) via the Hidden Path (41.74), then leave east.
ROUTES.flag: Classic route. wowforever.one lists Stoneskin Totem as a level-4 trainer spell, which Call of Earth used to grant: check in game whether that quest still matters.

steps: Up the crypt stairs: Undertaker Mordo (30.72), Rude Awakening. Kill bats and wolves on the way down for junk.
Church (31.66): turn in, take The Mindless Ones; Warlock: take Piercing the Veil and learn Immolate.
North in the village (32.61): Rattlecage Skeletons for Piercing the Veil, turn in, summon the Imp. Zombies down the hill (32.63) for The Mindless Ones.
Church: turn in; take Tainted Scroll, Rattling the Rattlecages and The Damned. Turn in Tainted Scroll at the Warlock trainer.
The Damned (wolves and bats) and Rattlecage Skeletons around 32.60. Turn in, take Marla's Last Wish, train level-4 spells (at least Corruption).
Outside the church (32.66): Scavenging Deathknell (equipment boxes, 32.64) and Night Web's Hollow (spiders, mine at 27.59). Turn in, take The Scarlet Crusade.
Scarlet humans east (37.67); Samuel Fipps (37.62) for Marla's Last Wish, then Marla's Grave (31.65). Turn in.
The Red Messenger: Meven Korgal (37.69). Turn in, take Vital Intelligence; leave NE, A Rogue's Deal (38.57), on to Brill.
ROUTES.flag: Classic route. wowforever.one lists Summon Imp as a level-1 trainer spell, so Piercing the Veil may be gone or optional: check the trainer first.

steps.text: Undertaker Mordo (30.2, 71.7), outside the crypt: Rude Awakening, for Shadow Priest Sarvis in the church.
Venya Marthand, in the church: Piercing the Veil (Warlock only), 3 Rattlecage Skulls from the skeletons north-east.
You start broke: sell a bit of loot to Joshua Kien, then train at Maximillion (30.9, 66.3).
Sarvis: The Mindless Ones (8 Mindless + 8 Wretched Zombies), then Tainted Scroll to Maximillion and Rattling the Rattlecages (12 skeletons).
The Damned (6 Scavenger Paws, 6 Duskbat Wings), Scavenging Deathknell (Equipment Boxes), Night Web's Hollow from Executor Arren.
Level 4: train Corruption and Curse of Weakness at Maximillion.
Night Web's Hollow: 10 Young + 10 Night Web Spiders.
steps.tip: Keep the Night Web Matriarch (5) at the cave's north end out of your pulls.

steps.text: A Light in the Darkness (new in Forever), The Scarlet Crusade (12 armbands), Marla's Last Wish: Samuel Fipps (5) is by the graveyard.
The Red Messenger: Meven Korgal, then Vital Intelligence and The Adventurer for Brill.
On the road east: A Rogue's Deal (Calvin Montague), Fields of Grief (Deathguard Simmer), Gordo's Task (Gordo walks the road).
Brill: Vital Intelligence to Executor Zygand. Keep At War With The Scarlet Crusade in the log; its 4 parts run to 12.
Eleanor Shackleton (57.3, 55.5): The Adventurer, Sticks and Bones, The Great Outdoors (sit at her fire about a minute), Camping 101: Cooking. All new in Forever.
Level 6: train Life Tap and Shadow Bolt rank 2 at Rupert Boch (61.6, 52.4, upstairs in the inn). Make Innkeeper Renee your home.
Discipline and Patience (Zygand, new), A New Plague (Apothecary Johaan), A Putrid Task, Hides for the Forsaken (Shelene Rhobart, Balnir).
West loop: Putrid Claws, darkhound blood and hides, Gloom Weed, pumpkins, 10 Scarlet Warriors, Seeking Refuge.
steps.tip: Cursed Darkhounds roam among the darkhounds; three Scarlet Warriors stand together on Bareth Dawnstone's top floor.

steps.text: Hearth to Brill. Grimoire of Blood Pact (Rank 1) from Gina Lang (61.5, 52.6) for the Imp.
North: Graverobbers and Doom Weed at the Rot Hide gnoll camps, Vile Fin murlocs on the coast. Loot every Agamand Mills undead for A Letter Undelivered.
Level 8: train Bane of Agony and Fear.
Voidwalker: Halgar's Summons from Ageron Kargal (upstairs in the Brill inn). Your notes: this Undercity-side quest is much easier than the Orc and Troll one.
steps.tip: Creature of the Void: Egalin's Grimoire is in Perrine's Chest beside Captain Perrine (51.1, 67.6).

steps.text: Level 10: train Drain Soul, Create Healthstone, Demon Skin 2, Immolate 2. Spend your first talent point.
Balnir Farmstead: The Cult of the Damned and Remnants of War (new), Rear Guard Patrol, Tomb Weed.
steps.tip: Dark Enforcers (10-12) hit hard with an instant strike. Fight at full health.

steps.text: Maggot Eye, then Agamand Mills: Deaths in the Family, The Haunted Mills, The Mills Overrun. Gunther's island: The Lich's Spellbook.
Captain Vachon's camp at the Crusader Outpost: keep the Linen Cloth. Bind on Forever calls it the last good source before Silverpine.
Level 12: train Health Funnel, Shadow Bolt 3, Curse of Weakness 2. Proving Allegiance (Lillith Nefara, 12), Captain Melrache, The Family Crypt.
Delivery to Silverpine Forest from Johaan, then out through the Undercity.

feed_rows.title: Corvin: Wrack more than doubled, Amplify Curse fixed, Drain Soul shards need kills
feed_rows.detail: Wrack base damage at 60 goes from 36 to 86 per second (+2.5 per level) and its spell damage coefficient doubles to 0.286 per second. Amplify Curse now really boosts Bane of Agony and Curse of Exhaustion, and Bane of Agony updates its damage while it runs. Drain Soul's chance to give a Soul Shard from damage (no kill) is cut a lot; kills still give one. Demons now get 2 Health per point of your Stamina (was 7.5), so pets are squishier. Spellstone now boosts Shadow damage only (fine for Affliction, no Fire help for Demonology). Shadow and Flame is 4/8/12/16/20% (was 2-10%). Training 1-60 costs 206-207 gold, with Warlock costs cut by the expected grimoire price. Most of this lands by server hotfix, not yet in the client. Read Nov 3, 9:30 AM ET.

feed_rows.title: Vorgash: Stormstrike 150% on a 6 s cooldown, shocks back to Classic damage
feed_rows.detail: Stormstrike deals 150% normalized weapon damage (was 100%) on a 6 sec cooldown (was 8). Maelstrom Weapon triggers twice as often. Mental Dexterity gives 50/100/150% of Intellect as Attack Power (was 33/67/100). Flurry is 6/12/18/24/30% (was 5-25). All shocks return to Classic Era base damage. Lightning Bolt base damage is up on every rank (top rank +80%); Chain Lightning becomes a 2.5 s cast. Totemic Projection becomes Totemic Call: totems jump to where you stand, 30 sec cooldown. Improved Ghost Wolf moves from row 2 to row 4, so it can't be one of the first leveling points any more. Lava Burst is removed for Call of Thunder (+5% crit on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning) and Elemental Mastery is renamed Lightning Mastery. Read Nov 3, 9:30 AM ET.

naga_when_to_swap.text: When three or more Shift binds feel like they should be one press (Enhancement around 32–40, Warlocks at 40 with Death Coil and Howl of Terror, Wrack joining at 51). Swap once, at a rest stop, not mid-dungeon. The 12-plate is a 4-row grid, not two columns, so every thumb position is new: expect a couple of sessions of fumbling, which is why the old 1–6 slots stay as close to the top as possible.
